verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document AI decisioning agents that autonomously choose messages, timing, and channels per customer within user-set guardrails, nor any measurement of lift. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: AI-powered audience building, rule-based audiences, and event-triggered messaging. None of these is autonomous per-customer decisioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
